title: Crispy Algerian Lamb Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl dish from Algeria, made with crispy lamb and served with a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Season the lamb with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb on all sides until browned, then transfer to the oven.
Roast the lamb in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, slice the onion and garlic.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the tomatoes, cucumber, and crispy lettuce to the skillet.
Serve the lamb on top of the vegetable mixture in a bowl.
Garnish with additional crispy lettuce and serve immediately.
